digest_input: RFC 8785-style JSON with recursively bytewise-sorted object keys over every row field except semantic_digest

evidence_record_contract.revision_rule: tested_revision identifies the original execution tree and gate_execution_revision identifies the ledger gate tree; when they are equal revalidation_revision MUST be null, and when they differ revalidation_revision MUST equal gate_execution_revision and the complete input manifest and input_root MUST validate identically at both revisions
evidence_record_contract.record_commit_rule: the payload MUST NOT contain or predict the commit that contains itself; coordinator state binds the repository path, exact blob SHA-256 and later evidence-record commit, and that commit MUST be an ancestor of the verification/finalization commit
evidence_record_contract.committed_bytes_rule: validation reads the blob from the bound evidence-record commit and requires it to equal both the declared digest and the bytes parsed; working-tree existence or bytes alone are insufficient

artifact_observation_contract.artifact_specific_schema_rule: each artifact_catalog schema is a distinct behavioral payload schema for that artifact ID, not a label for a shared free-form report
artifact_observation_contract.required_observation_id_rule: each schema MUST enumerate nonempty exact observation IDs prefixed by its artifact ID and allocated to every behavior that the artifact proves for its listed claims and operation_claims
artifact_observation_contract.behavior_rule: observations MUST exercise observable success plus every applicable denial, failure, outage, replay, concurrency, cleanup and unknown-outcome recovery boundary allocated to that artifact; a summary string, source-text assertion, schema label, command name or passing result without those observations is invalid
artifact_observation_contract.mutation_rule: schema validation fixtures MUST reject a missing required observation, an observation attributed to another artifact or claim, a missing expected or actual outcome, a non-pass observation, and a hash not present in artifact_hashes

required_input_classes: all production code, tests, fuzz corpora, fixtures, migrations, generated files, documentation, examples, go.mod and go.sum files beneath every affected module and reverse dependant
modules.json, packages.json, go.work, go.work.sum and every owned dependency selected by the affected graph
repository gate scripts, shared gate libraries, gate configuration, pinned tool and action versions, required service images and service configuration

END_STATE.md, END_STATE_ACCEPTANCE.json, REFERENCE_PROFILE.md, API_OPERATIONS.md, OPERATION_SEMANTICS.json, SECURITY_EVENTS.md, TRANSACTION_CONTRACT.md, LIFECYCLE_CASCADES.md, LIFECYCLE_CONSUMERS.md, SHARED_CONTRACT_APPLICABILITY.json, PROTOCOL_BASELINES.md, PROTOCOL_CONFORMANCE_MANIFEST.json, REFERENCE_CONFIGURATION.md, CONFIGURATION_CATALOGS.json, VERIFICATION_APPLICABILITY.json, BETTER_AUTH_PARITY.md, PARITY_DISPOSITIONS.json, UPSTREAM_DISPOSITIONS.md, UPSTREAM_SURFACE.json, COMMON_REQUIREMENTS.md and every applicable goal
toolchain, operating-system, architecture, behavior-affecting environment variables, external profile identities and required service-image identities
input_identity_contract.exhaustiveness_rule: the manifest MUST enumerate every behavior-affecting input in the required classes, use sorted unique entries, and fail closed when ownership or input identity cannot be resolved; a fixed shortlist or semantic digest over planning manifests alone is insufficient
input_identity_contract.input_root_rule: input_root is sha256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the complete manifest and is the acceptance fingerprint used for invalidation and reuse
